workExperiences.company: Cottonhollow University, Department of Forest Sciences
descriptions: Lead a three-year study of shrub and tree recovery on 48 plots across two wildfire scars
Built the lab's R workflow for cleaning plot data and fitting recovery models, which five other projects in the department now use for their own field data
Mentor two graduate students and four undergraduates; this year two of the undergraduates designed their own small projects and presented posters

workExperiences.company: Albemoor University, Department of Integrative Biology
descriptions: Measured seed removal by birds at 60 burned and unburned sites over four field seasons, about 14,000 seed trap checks in all, with a crew of two to five people
Wrote the field protocol and safety plan for remote burn sites, now the lab's standard
Ran camera trap surveys with a state wildlife agency and published the cleaned data set
Dissertation: How birds move seeds into burned forest, and what that means for recovery

descriptions: Graduated summa cum laude; honors thesis on pollinator visits to urban meadow plots
